name: Shephali Bhatt
tagline: Writing about the internet, culture, and the people living inside both.
intro: I'm a journalist based in India. I report on technology, internet culture and the quiet ways the online world reshapes everyday life. My work has appeared in Mint, Mint Lounge and The Economic Times, and I now write independently, including a newsletter called Living Things.
about_paragraphs: SAMPLE COPY. For more than a decade I have reported on how people use, love and push back against technology: creators building careers out of their bedrooms, the economics of attention, and the small rituals that make the internet feel like home.

At Mint and Mint Lounge I wrote long-form features on digital culture; before that I covered brands and media at The Economic Times. Today I write independently and publish Living Things, a newsletter about technology and the living.
I care about clear sentences, curious questions, and stories that treat readers as smart, busy people.
